fire: The mill was built in 1820 to grind local wheat. Today, it houses a small museum and a cafe.

The recipe came over with immigrants from Sicily a century ago, and it is still served at every family wedding.
Rubber was first collected from wild trees in the Amazon. Today, most of it comes from plantations in Asia.
The bridge was finished in 1883 after fourteen years of work. Today it carries over a hundred thousand cars a day.
The monks copied the manuscripts by hand in the twelfth century, and many of them are still read by scholars.
Chess spread from India to Persia and then to Europe. Today, millions of people play it online every day.
